Fixed and pushed as a3bb0ff (main -> origin/main).

Cause: desktop/package.json asked for ^2.4.0, so pnpm installed the JS 2.4.0, but the Rust crate 2.4.0 depends on tauri ^2.12 while this app locks tauri 2.11.5 (and @tauri-apps/api 2.11.1). Cargo therefore kept tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager at 2.3.3 — the newest release compatible with the locked tauri — and the Tauri CLI's gate refused the build because the JS and Rust minors differed.

Fix: one release named on both sides. package.json now pins exactly "2.3.3" (no caret, so a later pnpm install cannot drift the JS ahead of the crate) and Cargo.toml requires "2.3.3" like the other pinned plugin crates. pnpm-lock.yaml is updated and its diff is confined to that one package (specifier, resolution, snapshot).

Verification: `pnpm tauri info` now exits 0 with no mismatched-package line, reporting tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager 2.3.3 (Rust) and @tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager 2.3.3 (JS); `cargo check --release --all-targets` compiles the lib, bin and tests cleanly (pre-existing warnings only), so the release compile behind `tauri build` is covered; `tsc --noEmit` clean; `vitest run src/chat` 253 passed with the 2.3.3 JS (its `readImage` API is unchanged). Not run: a full `pnpm desktop:build`, because project rules forbid producing installer bundles for testing, and the CLI gate was the only reported blocker. The same caret-vs-pinned trap is noted in project memory for the other @tauri-apps/plugin-* dependencies.

Reported: `pnpm desktop:build` fails before compiling with "Found version mismatched Tauri packages. tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager (v2.3.3) : @tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager (v2.4.0)" — a regression introduced by the clipboard-manager dependency added for the Linux image paste fix.

Expected: the desktop build passes the Tauri CLI's version gate.

Cause: desktop/package.json requested ^2.4.0 (pnpm installed 2.4.0), but the Rust crate 2.4.0 requires tauri ^2.12 while the app locks tauri 2.11.5, so cargo kept tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager at 2.3.3. The CLI requires same major/minor on both sides.

Fix: name exactly 2.3.3 on both sides (exact version in package.json, pinned requirement in Cargo.toml), matching the project's convention of pinning Tauri plugin crates.

data.title: Fix the Tauri plugin version mismatch that blocks the desktop build
